content.title: ‘The Chosen’ Season 6 Release Date And Streaming Schedule Are Finally Here
content.text: "The Chosen" Season 65&2 Studios/Prime Video/FacebookThere’s finally an update on the release of Season 6 of The Chosen, the next chapter of the popular faith-based series created by Dallas Jenkins. This time, viewers won’t need to head to theaters to watch the first episodes. Instead, most of the new season will debut directly on streaming.Prime Video and 5&2 Studios announced on Friday, April 3, that The Chosen Season 6 will premiere on Nov. 15, 2026, in the U.S. and internationally. The first three episodes will drop on Prime Video, followed by weekly releases through Dec. 6. The supersized season finale is set for a theatrical release in spring 2027.The rollout marks a shift from prior seasons, which debuted in theaters first before arriving on streaming months later. The change comes after Amazon MGM Studios struck a deal with 5&2 Studios in 2025, securing the streaming rights to the series, including the upcoming and final two seasons."The Chosen" Season 65&2 Studios/Prime Video/FacebookUnder the new schedule, only the Season 6 finale and the Season 7 premiere will receive theatrical releases. Those episodes are expected to arrive on Prime Video at a later date. Last year, Amazon MGM Studios and 5&2 Studios said these installments would be produced as standalone feature films “designed for the big screen experience.”“Everyone knows the basics of this part of the story, but not everyone knows the ‘why’ of the crucifixion and the extraordinary events of these 24 hours,” Jenkins said in a statement. “We realized this not only deserved a season of television but a standalone full-length theatrical event as well. We wrote and filmed all of it with this in mind."The Chosen Season 6 Release ScheduleThe Chosen5&2 Studios/Prime Video/Facebook Check out the full release schedule for The Chosen Season 6 below.Episode 1: Nov. 15, 2026, on Prime VideoEpisode 2: Nov. 15, 2026, on Prime VideoEpisode 3: Nov. 15, 2026, on Prime VideoEpisode 4: Nov. 22, 2026, on Prime VideoEpisode 5: Nov. 29, 2026, on Prime VideoEpisode 6: Dec. 6, 2026, on Prime VideoSeason 6 finale: Theatrical release in Spring 2027What Is The Chosen Season 6 About?The Chosen Season 55&2 Studios/Prime Video/FacebookSeason 6 of The Chosen will cover the final 24 hours of Jesus’ life leading up to the crucifixion.The official synopsis reads: “The hour has come. Before the sun sets, Jesus of Nazareth will be dead. Season Six captures the historic events of Jesus’ final day through the lives of those who love Him—and those who condemn Him. Pharisees call it justice. Romans call it peace. Followers call it murder. But in the face of loneliness and death, Jesus stands resolute in his plan that has always led to one place: the cross. The Chosen Season Six reveals how Jesus’ final hours changed the world forever."Despite covering just 24 hours, this season took significantly longer to film than previous installments. During filming, Jenkins told KSL TV in May 2025 that because most scenes take place at night, production also required overnight shoots.“It’s exhausting. This season is an 86-day shoot. It’s almost 20 days longer than any other season we’ve ever done,” Jenkins said at the time. “It’s the physical challenges, the logistical challenges that make it even harder.”Who’s In The Chosen Season 6 Cast?Madrid, Kingdom of Spain; 03.25, 2025 - European Premiere, presentation of the fifth season of the series "The Chosen," starring Jonathan Roumie (Jesus), Shahar Isaac (Simon/Peter), and Vanessa Benavente (Mary), along with other cast members such as Amber Shana Williams (Tamar), Abe Bueno Jallad (James the Greater), Reza Diako (Philip), Andrew James Allen (Pontius Pilate), and Alaa Safi (Simon the Zealot). Photo: Juan Carlos Rojas (Photo by Juan Carlos Rojas/picture alliance via Getty Images)picture alliance via Getty ImagesSeason 6 of The Chosen brings back many of the show’s series’s regulars. Here’s a list of who’s starring in the next chapter, according to Amazon.Jonathan Roumie as JesusShahar Isaac as PeterParas Patel as MatthewElizabeth Tabish as Mary MagdaleneNoah James as AndrewGeorge H. Xanthis as JohnAbe Bueno-Jallad as Big JamesVanessa Benavente as Mother MaryLuke Dimyan as JudasRichard Fancy as CaiaphasPaul Ben-Victor as King HerodAndrew James Allen as Pontius PilateAll five seasons of The Chosen are currently streaming on Prime Video.
